summary_zh: 泰國電動車政策轉向保護在地製造：財政部擬提高在泰組裝電動車消費稅並封堵「零美元工廠」漏洞，進口稅擬提高至35%，業者加速在泰設廠，廣汽電池包工廠已投產。另泰國抽查80家工廠，1家停工、63家限期改善，合規壓力浮現。
summary_en: Thailand's EV policy tilts toward local manufacturing: higher excise on locally assembled EVs, closing 'zero-dollar factory' loopholes, a 35% import tax, and GAC's battery-pack plant now producing. Of 80 factories inspected, 1 was shut and 63 must fix issues by deadlines.

items.title: GAC opens first overseas battery factory in Thailand
items.summary_zh: 廣汽集團在泰國的首座海外自研電池包工廠已開始生產，支援電動車供應鏈在地化。
items.summary_en: GAC's first overseas self-developed battery pack plant has begun production in Thailand, supporting localisation of its EV supply chain.

items.title: คลังลุยต่อขึ้นภาษีสรรพสามิตรถ EV ประกอบในไทย ปิดช่องโหว่ "โรงงานศูนย์เหรียญ"
items.summary_zh: 財政部擬提高泰國組裝電動車的消費稅，並封堵「零美元工廠」的稅務漏洞。
items.summary_en: Thailand's Finance Ministry plans to raise excise tax on locally assembled EVs and close the zero-dollar factory loophole.

items.title: FTI Backs Government’s 35% EV Import Tax Hike to Support Domestic Manufacturing
items.summary_zh: 泰國工業聯合會支持政府將電動車進口稅提高至35%，以扶持國內製造業。
items.summary_en: The Federation of Thai Industries backs the government's plan to raise the EV import tax to 35% to support domestic manufacturing.

items.title: EV จีน-เทสลา ระส่ำโดนโขกภาษี 35% จ่อขึ้นราคาหลักแสน เร่งตั้งโรงงานในไทย
items.summary_zh: 中國品牌與特斯拉電動車遭加徵35%稅，價格恐上漲，業者加速在泰設廠。
items.summary_en: Chinese EVs and Tesla face a 35% tax that may raise prices; makers are rushing to set up plants in Thailand.

items.title: 80 Thai factories checked, one halted and 63 ordered to improve
items.summary_zh: 泰國抽查80家工廠，1家停工、63家被要求限期改善。
items.summary_en: Thailand inspected 80 factories; one was halted and 63 were ordered to make improvements.

items.summary_en: Vermicelli maker Ton Son reports good response at Makro HORECA 2026 and plans to build on the results.
